terms.title: General Terms and Conditions (GTC)
terms.s1Text:
(1) These General Terms and Conditions (hereinafter "GTC") apply to the use of the B2B platform Cannathera (hereinafter "Platform"), operated by Dominique Larkin (hereinafter "Provider").
(2) The service is exclusively aimed at commercial users, in particular physicians, medical professionals, telemedicine practitioners, and pharmacies (hereinafter "Users" or "Partners"). Use by consumers within the meaning of Section 13 of the German Civil Code (BGB) is excluded.
(3) Deviating or conflicting terms and conditions of the Users are not recognized unless the Provider has expressly agreed to their validity in writing.
terms.s2Text:
(1) Cannathera provides Users with a web-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform that serves for the structured support, triage assistance, and documentation of the progress of cannabinoid therapies.
(2) The platform serves as a digital hub for secure networking between healthcare providers, pharmacies, and patients.
(3) Important note: The provider does not provide any medical, pharmaceutical, or physician services. The platform serves solely as a technical documentation and evaluation tool. Medical responsibility remains 100% with the treating physician or the cooperating institution.
terms.s3Text:
(1) The contract is concluded upon the user's registration on the platform and acceptance by the provider (or the conclusion of a cooperation agreement).
(2) If a discounted pilot or test phase has been agreed upon, it will run for the period specified in the offer (3 months by default).
(3) After the pilot phase, the contract will automatically convert into a regular, paid subscription at the agreed standard rate, unless it is terminated in writing by either party with 4 weeks' notice prior to the end of the pilot phase.
terms.s4Text:
(1) The user receives a simple, non-transferable right to use the platform within the framework of the contractual agreements, limited to the duration of the contract.
(2) The user is obligated to keep their login credentials (including 2FA verification) confidential and to protect them from unauthorized access by third parties.
(3) The user is solely responsible for the accuracy of the data entered by them and their patients. They warrant that the use of the platform complies with applicable data protection (GDPR) and professional regulations.
terms.s5Text:
(1) The protection of personal and medical data is of utmost priority. All data is processed and stored according to the current state of the art (including AES-256 encryption).
(2) Insofar as the provider processes personal data on behalf of the user, the parties will conclude a corresponding data processing agreement (DPA) pursuant to Article 28 GDPR.
terms.s6Text:
(1) The provider is liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence. For slight negligence, the provider is only liable for breaches of essential contractual obligations (cardinal obligations), the fulfillment of which is a prerequisite for the proper execution of the contract.
(2) Since the platform relies on internet connections, third-party server services, and IT infrastructure, absolute, uninterrupted availability (100%) is not guaranteed. Maintenance work, security updates, or unforeseen outages due to force majeure may lead to temporary limitations.
(3) The provider assumes no liability for medical errors, diagnostic decisions, or treatment outcomes made by physicians or telemedicine practitioners based on platform data.
terms.s7Text:
(1) The contract term is determined by the respective individual contract or the selected subscription level.
(2) Unless otherwise agreed, the contract is automatically renewed for the duration of the initial term unless terminated by either party with four weeks' notice prior to the end of the current term.
(3) The right to extraordinary termination for good cause remains unaffected.
terms.s8Text:
(1) The laws of the Federal Republic of Germany shall apply.
(2) The place of jurisdiction for all disputes arising from this contract shall be the registered office of the provider, provided the user is a merchant, a legal entity under public law, or a special fund under public law.
(3) Should any provision of these Terms and Conditions be or become invalid, the validity of the remaining provisions shall remain unaffected.

cancellation.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.s1Text: Since the Cannathera platform is intended exclusively for commercial users (doctors, medical professionals, telemedicine practitioners, and pharmacies) in the course of their professional or commercial activities, there is no statutory right of withdrawal pursuant to Section 355 of the German Civil Code (BGB).
cancellation.s2Text:
(1) Contracts and subscriptions may be terminated with four weeks' notice to the end of the respective contract term, subject to any differing individual agreements (e.g., during a pilot phase).
(2) The right to extraordinary termination for good cause remains unaffected for both parties at any time.
(3) Any termination must be in writing (e.g., by email to support) to be effective.

questions.a4: Rules are defined per questionnaire in the database. Critical answers immediately raise an alert on your dashboard.
questions.q5: How do I start a video consultation?
questions.a5: From the appointment briefing or the patient record. The Zoom integration is activated with module M9.
questions.a6: Yes — questionnaires, questions and alert rules are data, not code. New forms appear without an update.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Protecting your personal data — in particular your health data — is Cannathera's highest priority. We process your data exclusively on the basis of the applicable law (GDPR, BDSG) and this privacy policy.

sections.controller: Cannathera, owner: Dominique Larkin, Hügelstr. 1, 46117 Oberhausen. Email: d.larkin@cannathera-report.de
sections.data: Master data (name, email address, date of birth), access data (passwords stored encrypted), health data within the therapy accompaniment (Art. 9 GDPR), and technical log data (audit log).
sections.purpose: Your health data is processed exclusively on the basis of your explicit consent (Art. 9 (2) (a) GDPR), which you give at registration and may withdraw at any time. Other data is processed to perform the contract (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR) and to comply with legal obligations (Art. 6 (1) (c) GDPR).
sections.sharing: Your course reports are transmitted to your treating doctors or your pharmacy only with your separate consent. Without consent, no data is shared.
sections.storage: Your data is processed encrypted (in transit and at rest) on servers in Germany (AWS Frankfurt, eu-central-1). Passwords are stored as hashes only. All access is logged.
sections.rights: You have the right of access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection (Art. 21 GDPR). You may withdraw consent at any time with future effect. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.
sections.retention: We store personal data only for as long as is necessary for the stated purposes or as long as statutory retention obligations apply. After you withdraw your consent, health data is deleted unless a legal obligation to retain it exists.

hero.title:
Your Therapy.
Meticulously Structured.
hero.v2_subtitle: Whether it's questions about dosage, confusing notes, or the missing link between patient, doctor's office, and pharmacy: successful cannabinoid therapy often fails in everyday practice due to coordination issues. Cannathera closes this gap as your intelligent, clinically supported digital hub. We seamlessly connect practitioners and patients, automate progress documentation, and create the valid database necessary for true therapy safety. Become part of Cannathera – for transparent, legally compliant, and structured support from day one.

features.title: A Complete Ecosystem for Therapy Accompaniment
features.subtitle: Cannathera bridges the gap between clinicians, pharmacies, and patients by translating complex therapy regimes into structured, secure, data-driven progress workflows.
features.patientDescSuffix: Securely record symptoms, dosages, and daily activity. Track adherence metrics in real-time.
features.doctorDescSuffix: Automated triage protocols monitor patient values. Generate structured PDF course reports with one click.

trust.subtitle: Patient health records are highly sensitive. Cannathera utilizes advanced end-to-end encryption protocols and structural isolation architectures to guarantee data protection.
trust.gdprDesc: Strictly patient-consented medical processing. Health details are isolated and only shared with treating physicians upon explicit release.
trust.aesDesc: All databases are fully encrypted. Data packets are secure both in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest.
trust.auditDesc: Full tracking transparency. Every system change, access instance, or data transfer creates a cryptographically signed audit log.
trust.verifiedDesc: Cryptographic systems audited against argon2id hashing, TLS 1.3 transmission, and MFA access control guidelines.

founder.title: Clinically-Led Therapy Accompaniment
founder.subtitle: Cannathera is based on real-world nursing experience, not theoretical market analyses. Dominique Larkin's background as a certified geriatric nurse, with additional training in outpatient intensive care, many years of practical experience since 2016, and his own perspective as a cannabis patient since 2021, ensures that every questionnaire, every threshold value, and every triage procedure is practical and geared towards genuine patient safety. This is further complemented by successfully completed training as a cannabis consultant (ACM), in cannabis in medicine, and a specialised nursing consultant qualification.
founder.role: Certified Geriatric Nurse · Outpatient Intensive Care Training · Cannabis Patient since 2021 · Founder & Owner
founder.quote: The greatest vulnerability in the entire healthcare system is the lack of structured accompaniment between medical appointments.
founder.philosophyDesc: We do not replace physicians or pharmacists; we provide the structure they need. Patients carry out their daily lives, pharmacies supply high-grade care, and physicians manage treatment decisions. Cannathera accompanies the path between them by structuring, documenting, and transparently mapping outcomes.
founder.clinicalFocusDesc: Every piece of documentation is optimized to minimize the administrative burden on practices.
founder.patientSafetyDesc: Intelligent triage protocols automatically flag warning indicators (such as pain NRS ≥ 8).
founder.unfairSubtitle: A pure software developer or classic business administration founder would never have designed this system in this form. They can never truly design a form. They don't know the reality of clinical practice. Dominique's solid clinical background is the key:
founder.unfair0Desc: Speaks the language of physicians fluently and understands clinical workflows firsthand.
founder.unfair1Desc: Targeted avoidance of administrative hurdles that burden physicians in their daily work and cost valuable time.
founder.unfair2Desc: Triage logic and questionnaires are based on genuine nursing and patient experience, not market speculation.
founder.philosophy_text_1: We do not replace doctors or pharmacists – we create the precise clinical structure that significantly reduces their workload in their daily practice and provides close support to patients. Successful cannabis therapy is not a rigid short-term sprint, but a continuous, long-term journey that requires maximum data security and complete transparency. While patients manage their treatment independently in everyday life, pharmacies ensure safe supply and dosage determination, and physicians make medical decisions, Cannathera closes the potentially dangerous gaps between doctor's visits.
founder.philosophy_text_2: Through sound, practical risk management, validated triage logic, and fully GDPR-compliant, AES-256-encrypted documentation, we ensure that neither doctors nor pharmacies have blind spots. The result is a new dimension of therapy safety: All progress data, pain scales, and tolerability information are available completely, in a structured format, and at a medical level – for maximum treatment quality from day one and throughout the entire, ongoing course of therapy.
founder.section1_text: As a certified geriatric nurse with years of experience in outpatient intensive care, I have seen firsthand and in my daily work where conventional documentation fails: A chaotic mess of paperwork, unstructured patient notes, and missing data between quarters jeopardize the success of therapy. Cannathera wasn't developed on the drawing board or out of purely economic interest, but as a direct response to the real problems on the ground. We give doctors and pharmacists back the reliability they need to safely care for their patients.
founder.section2_title: A Closed Loop for Maximum Security
founder.section2_text: Cannabis therapy only works through the collaborative efforts of the prescribing physician, the dispensing pharmacy, and the patient in their daily life. Where interface issues and information gaps previously hampered the process, Cannathera connects all involved parties via a secure, data protection-compliant architecture. No anonymous algorithms, but clinically sound logic that puts people first.

footer.description: Structured clinical therapy accompaniment connecting patients, practitioners, and pharmacies securely.

disclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
disclaimer.s1Title: No Substitute for Professional Medical Advice
disclaimer.s1Text:
(1) The content, functions, automated evaluations, and reports provided via Cannathera serve solely as a technical documentation and analysis tool to support healthcare providers and pharmacies.
(2) The platform does not constitute medical, physician, or pharmaceutical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendation by the provider. The use of the software never replaces a personal consultation with a physician, examination, or independent professional diagnosis.
disclaimer.s2Text:
(1) All medical decisions, dosage adjustments, prescriptions, and treatment steps are the sole responsibility of the treating physician or other medical professional.
(2) The provider assumes no liability for the accuracy, completeness, or clinical relevance of the data entered by the patient. Technical analyses or AI-supported monthly summaries are merely guidelines and do not relieve the healthcare provider of their own judgment.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about the Cannathera platform for patients, doctors, and pharmacies.

questions.question: What is Cannathera?
questions.answer: Cannathera is a comprehensive software platform designed specifically to support and track medical cannabis therapies. We connect patients, doctors, and pharmacies to ensure seamless, data-driven treatment plans.

questions.question: How do I join as a patient?
questions.answer: Patients typically join Cannathera by receiving an invitation link from their treating physician or an integrated pharmacy. You can also sign up directly and connect with your clinic later.

questions.question: Is my health data secure?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We employ state-of-the-art encryption and strictly adhere to GDPR compliance standards. Your medical data is hosted securely in Germany and is never shared without your explicit consent.

questions.question: What features are available for medical practices?
questions.answer: For doctors and clinics, Cannathera offers a premium portal to monitor patient progress, manage electronic prescriptions (e-prescriptions), review daily symptom logs (Active Accompaniment), and securely exchange documents.

questions.question: Do you support pharmacies?
questions.answer: Yes, our pharmacy portal allows seamless integration for prescription fulfillment, inventory tracking, and direct communication with both patients and prescribing clinics.

questions.question: What is Active Accompaniment?
questions.answer: Active Accompaniment (Aktive Begleitung) is our signature feature that prompts patients to log their daily symptoms and medication effects. This real-time data helps doctors fine-tune dosages precisely.

physicians.title: For Physicians
physicians.subtitle: Relieving the burden on physicians through structured, continuous, and long-term therapy monitoring.
physicians.benefits_text: Complete, physician- and practice-oriented progress data instead of unstructured patient notes. Track symptom progression, pain scales, and tolerability in real time.
physicians.compliance_text: Fully GDPR compliant, AES-256 encrypted, and certified as a Class I Medical Device.
physicians.hero_title: Structured progress data, absolute therapy safety, and noticeable relief in everyday practice
physicians.hero_intro: As physicians in private practice, pain therapists, and prescribing specialists, you bear medical responsibility for the treatment of your patients. Especially with cannabinoid therapies, close monitoring and continuous adjustments are crucial for therapeutic success. However, everyday practice is characterized by a lack of time, unstructured patient notes on scraps of paper or in emails, and a lack of valid measurements between quarterly appointments. Cannathera closes this dangerous information gap and provides you with the precise, clinically structured data basis you need for efficient and safe prescribing.
physicians.f1_text: No more messy notes. With just one click, you receive structured PDF reports that depict the precise course of symptoms, validated pain scales, and everyday tolerability.
physicians.f2_text: Our system monitors defined thresholds in the background. In the event of unexpected side effects or deviations from the prescribed therapy, our validated triage logic kicks in, ensuring you are alerted promptly and in compliance with legal requirements.
physicians.f3_text: The platform meets the strictest legal requirements. It operates in full GDPR compliance, uses secure AES-256 encryption, and is based on its status as a certified Class I medical device.
physicians.f4_text: We do not replace medical diagnosis or treatment decisions. Instead, we create the organizational structure that relieves you of administrative burdens and allows you to fully concentrate on patient care.

pharmacies.title: For Pharmacies
pharmacies.subtitle: Targeting pharmacies that supply and care for cannabis patients.
pharmacies.hero_title: Transparency in strain selection, support in determining the dosage, and legally compliant processes
pharmacies.hero_intro: Pharmacies make an indispensable and highly sensitive contribution to the care of cannabis patients. The challenge begins with the initial prescription, extends to the individual, nuanced determination of the dosage, and requires ongoing support in daily practice. A smooth process often fails due to communication barriers between the patient, the prescribing practice, and the dispensing pharmacy. Cannathera connects all parties involved via a closed, digital platform to a secure ecosystem.
pharmacies.f1_title: Support in Dosage Finding & Product Selection
pharmacies.f1_text: Track documented tolerances, feedback loops, and therapy reports to provide pharmacy customers with well-founded and transparent support.
pharmacies.f2_text: Record dispensing, inventory, and side effects in a standardized, secure process that significantly simplifies interdisciplinary collaboration.
pharmacies.f3_text: Our system was developed based on real-world practical experience. It takes into account the high standards of professional qualifications, certified consultation, and legally compliant documentation requirements.
pharmacies.f4_text: Position your pharmacy as a modern, digitally networked point of contact that relieves the burden on medical practices through seamless data transfer and offers patients the highest level of care security.
pharmacies.val_text: Transparency in strain selection, support for patients in determining the correct dosage, and documentation of side effects as part of ongoing support.
pharmacies.comm_text: How the platform supports communication and a streamlined process between the patient, prescribing practice, and dispensing pharmacy.
pharmacies.qual_text: Information on professional qualifications (practical background and certified consultation) and how pharmacies can be involved as partners or points of contact.

telemedicine.title: For Telemedicine Providers
telemedicine.subtitle: Integration of digital, ongoing therapy support into fully digital treatment processes and remote consultations.
telemedicine.v2_hero_title: Seamless integration into fully digital treatment processes, maximum scalability, and legally compliant Remote Monitoring
telemedicine.v2_hero_intro: Telemedicine platforms, medical care centers, and digital healthcare providers stand for maximum efficiency, scalability, and purely digital treatment pathways. When physical practice rooms are replaced by digital consultations, seamless, automated follow-up care for patients in their home environment is the decisive factor for quality and patient safety. Cannathera offers the ideal infrastructure to perfectly complement digital remote treatments with structured, ongoing therapy support.
telemedicine.v2_f1_title: Minimizing liability risks in remote treatments
telemedicine.v2_f1_text: In remote treatment, platforms operate in complex regulatory territory. With our validated triage logic and automated threshold alerts, your telemedicine physicians have complete documentation at their fingertips at all times that the patient was closely monitored and that any abnormalities could be addressed immediately – demonstrably protecting against claims for damages and liability gaps.
telemedicine.v2_f2_title: Increased patient retention instead of one-off consultations
telemedicine.v2_f2_text: Say goodbye to fleeting, one-time users who just pick up their prescription and then leave. Cannathera's integrated, ongoing therapy support keeps patients engaged with your platform long-term, encouraging daily logins and a consistent anchor for their health.
telemedicine.v2_f3_title: Relieve the burden on physicians through structured pre-filtering
telemedicine.v2_f3_text: Instead of your doctors drowning in unstructured chat messages and emails, Cannathera completely filters out the background noise. Standardized pain scales, symptoms, and tolerances are presented in a way that allows telemedicine physicians to see only what is clinically relevant at a glance – maximizing throughput per physician and significantly reducing personnel costs.
telemedicine.v2_feat1_text: Seamlessly integrate our clinically guided, adaptive therapy support into your existing telemedicine processes and digital patient pathways.
telemedicine.v2_feat2_text: Utilize state-of-the-art API structures to monitor therapy progress securely and seamlessly across digital channels.
telemedicine.v2_feat3_title: Legally compliant triage and remote monitoring
telemedicine.v2_feat3_text: Remotely collect all therapy-relevant parameters and questionnaires according to the strictest security standards (GDPR-compliant and AES-256 encrypted).
telemedicine.v2_feat4_text: Offer your patients a highly professional, legally compliant environment that perfectly blends treatment quality, data protection, and state-of-the-art technology.

founder.philosophy_text_1: We do not replace doctors or pharmacists – we create the precise clinical structure that significantly reduces their workload in their daily practice and provides close support to patients. Successful cannabis therapy is not a rigid short-term sprint, but a continuous, long-term journey that requires maximum data security and complete transparency. While patients manage their treatment independently in everyday life, pharmacies ensure safe supply and dosage determination, and physicians make medical decisions, Cannathera closes the potentially dangerous gaps between doctor's visits.
founder.philosophy_text_2: Through sound, practical risk management, validated triage logic, and fully GDPR-compliant, AES-256-encrypted documentation, we ensure that neither doctors nor pharmacies have blind spots. The result is a new dimension of therapy safety: All progress data, pain scales, and tolerability information are available completely, in a structured format, and at a medical level – for maximum treatment quality from day one and throughout the entire, ongoing course of therapy.
founder.section1_text: As a certified geriatric nurse with years of experience in outpatient intensive care, I have seen firsthand and in my daily work where conventional documentation fails: A chaotic mess of paperwork, unstructured patient notes, and missing data between quarters jeopardize the success of therapy. Cannathera wasn't developed on the drawing board or out of purely economic interest, but as a direct response to the real problems on the ground. We give doctors and pharmacists back the reliability they need to safely care for their patients.
founder.section2_title: A Closed Loop for Maximum Security
founder.section2_text: Cannabis therapy only works through the collaborative efforts of the prescribing physician, the dispensing pharmacy, and the patient in their daily life. Where interface issues and information gaps previously hampered the process, Cannathera connects all involved parties via a secure, data protection-compliant architecture. No anonymous algorithms, but clinically sound logic that puts people first.
